general election.note: For the Turkish parliament the full form is 'milletvekilliği genel seçimi'.

primary.note: TDK spelling is 'önseçim'. Press and the Political Parties Law usually write it as two words.

runoff.note: Often 'ikinci tur seçimi'. Turkish presidential elections use this term.

by-election.note: This is the term in electoral law. 'Ara seçim' also means US midterms ('ABD ara seçimleri'), so context decides.

special election.note: Used in the press for US special elections. 'Ara seçim' is sometimes used when a vacancy is filled.

recall election.note: Turkey has no equivalent mechanism. This is the press rendering.

contest.note: Descriptive rendering. For one seat, 'yarış' is also fine.

ballot measure.note: Descriptive. The press also says 'oylama önergesi' or 'referandum maddesi'.

referendum.note: Used in the Constitution and in law. The press often uses 'referandum'.

proposition.note: 'Proposition 8' is rendered '8 numaralı öneri'. The press often keeps 'Proposition 8'.

retention election.note: No established Turkish equivalent. This is a descriptive rendering, usually explained at first mention.

incumbent.note: As a badge, 'Görevde'. Never 'görevdeki aday'. A defeated incumbent 'koltuğunu kaybetti'; a trailing one 'koltuğu tehlikede'.

write-in.note: A name the voter writes in by hand. Descriptive; Turkey has no write-in voting.

ballot.note: The term in electoral law. 'Oy kâğıdı' is an older variant.

votes cast.note: Also 'oy kullanan seçmen sayısı' when counting voters.

blank votes.note: Under Turkish law, blank ballots are counted as invalid.

turnout.note: The YSK also uses 'oy kullanma oranı'.

swing.note: Change in vote share between elections.

majority.note: More than half. 'Çoğunluk' alone is also common.

constituency.note: The legal term. In Turkey it usually corresponds to an il.

electoral district.note: Used for single-member areas abroad. Turkish law prefers 'seçim çevresi'.

ward.note: Used for UK-style wards. Sometimes explained as 'belediye seçim bölgesi'.

precinct.note: The Turkish legal analogue is 'sandık alanı'. The press often keeps 'precinct'.

polling station.note: The term in law. 'Sandık' is colloquial. The ballot box board is 'sandık kurulu'.

county.note: Used for US, UK, and Irish counties. Never 'kontluk'.

state.note: Used for US, Brazilian and German states. German Land is 'federal eyalet'.

region.note: Same word as 'district'. Context or a qualifier such as 'idari bölge' clarifies.

boundaries.note: Usually plural in use: 'seçim çevresi sınırları'.

redistricting.note: Descriptive. The press also says 'yeniden bölgelendirme'.

chamber.note: A legislative chamber. Use 'kamara' only inside established names such as 'Avam Kamarası' and 'Lordlar Kamarası'.

parliament.note: The Turkish parliament is TBMM, or 'Meclis'.

house of representatives.note: The US House is 'ABD Temsilciler Meclisi'.

governor.note: In Turkey valis are appointed. For the US, 'eyalet valisi' or 'Teksas Valisi'.

alliance.note: Established in Turkish electoral law, as in 'Cumhur İttifakı'.

overhang seat.note: German 'Überhangmandat'. The press also says 'fazla mandat'.

quota.note: Also 'seçim katsayısı' or 'Droop kotası' in the STV context.

proportional representation.note: The Constitution and law use 'nispi temsil'. The press also uses 'orantılı temsil'.

first past the post.note: Full form: 'tek turlu basit çoğunluk sistemi'. The press may add 'first-past-the-post' in brackets.

ranked-choice voting.note: The press often explains it as 'sıralı tercih sistemi'.

single transferable vote.note: Full form 'tek devredilebilir oy sistemi'. Sometimes written 'STV'.

mixed-member proportional.note: Also 'karma seçim sistemi'. German 'personalisierte Verhältniswahl' is rendered as 'kişiselleştirilmiş nispi temsil'.

count.note: A round of counting in STV or instant runoff.

results.note: The plural 'seçim sonuçları' is the more common form.

called.note: Used for a race whose winner is declared. Short form: 'kazananı belli oldu'.

absentee ballot.note: Descriptive. Turkey has no domestic absentee voting, only abroad and at border gates.

gerrymander.note: Usually kept in English. Descriptive Turkish: 'seçim bölgesi manipülasyonu'.

electoral college.note: The standard press rendering for the US body.

convention.note: US: 'ulusal kongre'. Not to be confused with the US Congress ('Kongre').

roll call.note: Press often explains it as a state-by-state delegate vote.

changeset.note: Technical term for a batch of edits.

secretary of state.note: A US state's Secretary of State. The office is 'Eyalet Sekreterliği'. Never 'Dışişleri Bakanı', which is a foreign minister.
